summary: Fatherless, and so alone. Rulers called themselves 孤, the orphan, in humility.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Burke–Shaw trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 遠 takes the point farthest from the system’s centre, 孤 the most isolated of the rest, and 寂 the point nearest the centre. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: Kings Call Themselves Orphans
satellites.evidence: Daodejing 42: 人之所惡，唯孤、寡、不穀，而王公以為稱 — what people hate is to be orphaned, widowed, unworthy, and these the kings and lords take as their titles. The loneliest names are worn by those at the top.
gaps: Open Daodejing ch. 42 in a reliable edition and record the passage.
